name: Cortlandt Crossing
summary: Cortlandt Crossing is a community shopping center in Mohegan Lake, New York, owned by Acadia Realty Trust. This open-air retail destination serves northern Westchester County with convenient access to everyday shopping and services along East Main Street.
demographics: Cortlandt Crossing serves the affluent northern Westchester County market, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $80,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area includes Mohegan Lake, Cortlandt Manor, and surrounding communities, drawing shoppers aged 25-65 who value convenience and quality. The center caters to busy suburban families seeking everyday necessities combined with specialty retail and dining options in a convenient open-air format.
description: Cortlandt Crossing is a well-established community shopping center located at 3144 East Main Street in Mohegan Lake, New York, serving the northern Westchester County market. Owned and managed by Acadia Realty Trust, a publicly-traded REIT specializing in high-quality retail properties, this open-air center has become a cornerstone destination for local residents seeking convenient access to everyday shopping and services. The center's strategic location along East Main Street provides excellent visibility and accessibility for the surrounding suburban communities of Cortlandt Manor, Mohegan Lake, and beyond. With extended operating hours from 6:00 AM to midnight, Cortlandt Crossing accommodates the busy schedules of working families and professionals throughout the day. The property maintains a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.4-star rating from 72 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction with its tenant mix and shopping experience.
